quote.summary: Hong Kong Robotics Group Holding Limited is an investment holding company principally engaged in the robotics and compute businesses. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Robotics and Compute Business segment is engaged in the sale of compute appliances and robots and the provision of robotics application solutions. The Geothermal Energy segment is engaged in the provision of heating and cooling supply by geothermal energy to buildings. The Money Lending segment is engaged in the money lending business. The Building Construction Contracting segment is engaged in the provision of building construction contracting services. The All Others segment is engaged in the property investment, property brokerage, construction and projects management as well as building architecture and interior design.
